npcs.name: Fen-Warden Alvor
npcs.greet: Another soot-blackened cellar on the boardwalk and torches seen moving toward the marsh cairns—Morthal won't sleep until the fen-brood is rooted out.

npcs.name: Hearth-Reader Jonna
npcs.greet: The Jarl's visions show blood-drinkers trading mining tallies with Stonehills while townsfolk point fingers at the court wizard.

npcs.name: Foreman Gestur
npcs.greet: Night-shift miners vanish between the adit and the old barrow-stones, and the torches burn cold green in the mist.

hjaalmarch_highmoon_vigil: Hearth-Reader Jonna: The blood-ledgers from Movarth's Lair prove the court wizard kept the marsh-wards standing when all others failed.
Fen-Warden Alvor: The boardwalk braziers burn steady again, and the night-watch holds the causeway to Stonehills.
Hearth-Reader Jonna: Highmoon Hall remembers who stood in the mist when the fen rose.

stages.objective: Inspect the charred foundations in Morthal with the fen-warden.
Search the marsh cache at the Abandoned Shack for the thrall's tally-scroll.
Warn the night-shift foreman at Stonehills and verify the missing miners' names.
Trace the disturbed boundary-runes at Kjenstag Ruins.
Defeat the vampire thrall-captain inside Folgunthur and recover the ritual phial.
Deliver the ritual phial to Highmoon Hall in Morthal to clear the court wizard's name.
Re-kindle the outer ward-pillar along the pass at Labyrinthian.
Assault Movarth's Lair and slay the vampire patriarch of the marsh brood.
Return the coven signet to Highmoon Hall in Morthal.
